core.title: Autumn Trophy dinner moves to the Terrace Suite
core.setting: The membership secretary at Dunmore Golf Club whose assistant manages handicap records, tee bookings, and competition entries

events.text: Standing instruction from me: once a supplier order above five hundred pounds has been confirmed, we do not change it without the supplier's written agreement first. Chase them, get a yes, then amend.
Club finance policy: any supplier order over one thousand pounds needs the treasurer's sign-off before it is placed, not after.
Hi Nora, can you check whether my handicap was updated after Saturday's card? I think it should be 14.2 now. Thanks!
Fixture calendar confirmed: the Dunmore Autumn Trophy qualifier is Saturday 24 October 2026, and the finals day is Saturday 14 November 2026, both at Dunmore Golf Club.
Just to say the tee booking system is working well. I've booked the 08:12 slot for Thursday again.
Caterer shortlist for the Autumn Trophy finals dinner: Harvest Catering (used them two years ago, good) and Latchfield Kitchens. Will get quotes.
Thank you for your enquiry. Our autumn dinner menu would be 21 pounds per head, service in the room of your choice, subject to availability.
Nora, I've paid my Autumn Trophy entry fee at the pro shop. Do I need to sign up separately for the finals dinner?
Looking at the entry list, we should plan the finals dinner on Saturday 14 November for about eighty covers. That is roughly what stayed for dinner last year.

Here is our quote for the Autumn Trophy finals dinner on Saturday 14 November: autumn dinner buffet at 18 pounds per head, minimum sixty covers, delivered and served in the Fairway Room. Quote valid until 31 October 2026.
Nora, happy to approve spend up to 1600 pounds for the finals dinner catering, per the finance policy on orders over a thousand. Send me the order when placed.
Booked the Autumn Trophy qualifier for Saturday 24 October on the club schedule: medal format, first tee times from 08:00.
Ordered three engraved trophies from Bramble Engraving for the Autumn Trophy, 240 pounds in total, for collection before finals day on 14 November.
Confirmation: the Fairway Room is reserved for the Autumn Trophy finals dinner on Saturday 14 November, laid out for eighty covers, from 19:00.

Placed the catering order with Harvest Catering for the finals dinner: eighty covers of the autumn dinner buffet at 18 pounds a head, 1440 pounds in total, delivered to the Fairway Room on Saturday 14 November. The treasurer had already approved the spend under the over-a-thousand policy.

Put the Autumn Trophy finals dinner on the club schedule, following the catering order just placed with Harvest: Saturday 14 November, 19:30, in the Fairway Room, eighty covers, catering confirmed at 18 pounds a head.
Set the dinner ticket price at 25 pounds per member: it covers Harvest's 18 pounds a head buffet and adds 7 pounds to club funds. Tickets go on sale from 20 September.
Ordered thirty bottles of house red and white mix from Costello Wines for the finals dinner, 405 pounds, collected from their depot the week before the 14th.
To-do: confirm final dinner numbers with Harvest Catering by 7 November, once entries close.

Order confirmed, thank you: eighty covers of the autumn dinner buffet at 18 pounds per head, 1440 pounds total, delivered and served in the Fairway Room on Saturday 14 November. We'll arrive from 17:30 to set up.
Published the finals day duty rota for Saturday 14 November: two starters on the first tee from 08:00 and scorers in the office all morning.
I've signed up for the finals dinner and I'm vegetarian - can you make sure the caterers know? Happy to pay the 25 pounds at the bar.
Your three trophies are engraved and ready for collection from the workshop any weekday before the finals.
Committee noted that Autumn Trophy preparations are on track: trophies ordered, Harvest Catering confirmed for eighty covers in the Fairway Room on 14 November, tickets selling steadily at 25 pounds.
Handicap query again - the system still shows 14.5 for me but I sent in two cards. Could you check?

Nora - the window refurbishment at the clubhouse has been brought forward, and the Fairway Room will be closed from 3 November. The Autumn Trophy dinner on Saturday 14 November will move to the Terrace Suite instead. Everything else stays as it is: Harvest's menu, price and numbers are unaffected, they will simply be delivering and serving in the Terrace Suite, which has its own service lift. Please update the arrangements on your side.
Finals day on Saturday 14 November: play will begin at 08:30 with two-tee starts, morning and afternoon rounds.
Clubhouse notice: the new heating units in the Terrace Suite have been commissioned and the suite is fully available for functions.
Early quote for the club Christmas party on 12 December: festive menu at 22 pounds per head, minimum forty covers. No commitment needed yet, just so you can plan.
Reminder to myself: entries close this week - confirm the final dinner details with Mira at Harvest in good time for the 14th.
Nora, with entries closing, please get the finals dinner confirmation over to Harvest Catering this week so the caterers have everything in writing. Douglas.
Signed my partner and myself up for the finals dinner yesterday, so add two to whatever list you have. See you on the 14th!
